subject: discrepancy between results in cim and summary(cim)

messages.author: 7b7af7697383276a
messages.subject: discrepancy between results in cim and summary(cim)
parts:
Hi

I have run the cim() function and obtained 5 QTL which are above the the threshold line. 2 of them are sitting on the same linkage group. 
When I run the summary(cim) function the position and the lod of only 4 QTL are displayed. The summary does not take into account 1 of the 2 QTL on the same LG (usually the one with the lowest score). The QTL are fairly far apart (one at the top and the other at the bottom of the LG).
The consequence of this is that I cannot fit the additive model to 5 QTL. 
Have you ever seen this?
Any suggestion for improvement?

thank you for your help,
Maria

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] discrepancy between results in cim and summary(cim)
parts:
Sorry; the summary function only picks out the single biggest peak on each chromosome. We don't have any facilities, at this point, to do the sort of "bump finding" that would be necessary.

You could do something like this:

# set up example using hyper data
data(hyper)
hyper <- calc.genoprob(hyper)
out <- scanone(hyper)

# there's a clear double-bump on chr 1
plot(out, chr=1)

# pick out the first peak
firstpeak <- max(out, chr=1)

# find second-highest that is at least 20 cM away from first
secondpeak <- max(out[out$chr==1 & abs(out$pos - firstpeak$pos) > 20,])

I prefer the stepwiseqtl function (e.g., with additive.only=TRUE) to CIM.

karl
